firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a graveyard starts and takes the Start Player card.
clarifications: Each round begins with that player and continues clockwise.

sources.title: Gloomy Graves Rulebook

internalEvidence: A complete publisher-authored English rulebook preserved by a game-rule archive was inspected. PDF page 4 was rendered and read; setup step 8 names the graveyard visitor. Page 5 confirms clockwise rounds. Publisher credits and game identity match inventory BGG 293556. SHA-256: d8622de199a9c51d3a9b99bd2524fa8cd3ecf2ee0a25a91cd683c57596e147ea. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the exact opening instruction, game identity and edition against the cited rendered rulebook.
uncertainty: No procedure is given for tied or no graveyard visits.
